name: net_session_config_dialog_get_message_map
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::GetMessageMap returns the recovered MFC message map for destroy and map-selection change handling. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c970 returns the NetSessionConfigDialog message-map object at 0x4d03d0; the table bytes contain a WM_DESTROY entry for OnDestroy and a WM_COMMAND/CBN_SELCHANGE entry for map combo id 1116 targeting OnMapChanged.
The native smoke verifies the returned message-map pointer, base map callback, entry array pointer, two recovered entries, handler member pointers, and sentinel entry.
